title: PULSE: An Executable Contract Language for Spatiotemporal Knowledge Graph Engineering
description:
arXiv:2608.02630v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Knowledge graph engineering often distributes accepted state, observations, constraints, processes, and hypothetical scenarios across artifacts whose combined execution contract remains external. We present PULSE, an Object-Process-Methodology-inspired language that localizes four operational roles and their write effects in one typed runtime.
